scope: Supplementary evidence for three existing PHBV-39 thermal records; no new values, identities, states or contract changes.

page_findings.confirmed: DSC series includes PHBV-39; panel (a) is second heating, panel (b) first cooling. This independently inspects the supplementary figure already cited by the main text.
page_findings.limits: No replicate/run identifiers, scalar aggregation rule, error bars or per-cell prior-study provenance are supplied. Curves were not digitized; peak temperatures and Tg remain sourced to Table 4, not estimated from this figure.

page_findings.confirmed: TGA and DTG series includes PHBV-39.
page_findings.limits: No TGA value accepted here; do not transfer TGA acquisition conditions to DSC. The upper panel uses a Weight Loss (%) label although curves descend from near 100; no reinterpretation or correction is made.

page_findings.confirmed: NMR spectrum and chemical shift table are explicitly for PHBV-61.
page_findings.limits: Not PHBV-39 composition evidence; no transfer of assay, sequence distribution or identity.

page_findings.confirmed: NMR sequence-distribution models, definitions and references.
page_findings.limits: No additional PHBV-39 DSC replicate attribution, scalar summary or conditioning information identified in these inspected pages; equations not validated or implemented.

use_boundaries: Method-level duplicate measurements in main section 2.2.5 do not establish selected scalar n=2; one plotted trace does not establish n=1.
Second heating and first cooling are acquisition phases, not independent material identities or statistical repetitions.
Do not apply mechanical vacuum drying at 60 degC overnight or mechanical specimen geometry to DSC.
Two melting peaks remain two source-labeled properties on one state, not an interval, mean or two materials.
Guho2020 full text and raw data were not obtained in this audit; lack of supplementary attribution cannot establish independent 2022 measurement.
License and scientific validity of uninspected prior-study content are not certified; no raw PDF or ZIP is added to the repository.
